[Act: juvenile-justice
 Chapter: Adoption
 Section: 64::Reporting of adoption.
]


Notwithstanding anything contained in any other law for the time being in force, information regarding all adoption orders issued by the 6[District Magistrate], shall be forwarded to Authority on monthly basis in the manner as provided in the adoption regulations framed by the Authority, so as to enable Authority to maintain the data on adoption.
